company.name: Rawa.tv
company.shortDescription: Rawa.tv is a live streaming platform dedicated to Arab gaming.
company.description:
Rawa.tv is a live streaming platform dedicated to Arab gaming. The platform's goal and vision is to gather all the Arab gaming community on one unique platform and bring Arab gaming under the spotlight.

Founded in 2019, Rawa.tv is headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $675,000, or 80.84% of reported total funding.

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
